title: Cisco, Nvidia Tackle AI’s Growing Data Center Bottleneck
text: Cisco is partnering with Nvidia on a new generation of optical networking technology designed to handle the exploding amount of data moving through AI data centers. Cisco President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel explains why increasingly powerful AI agents could consume far more network bandwidth than humans performing the same tasks, and how faster, more power-efficient connections could help hundreds of thousands of GPUs operate together while lowering the cost of AI. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
